findings_to_judge.finding: Netskope's Q1 FY27 cash flow statement shows the free-cash-flow reversal that produced the -19% June print was overwhelmingly working capital, not spending: the accounts-receivable collection tailwind shrank to $22.1M from $79.7M a year earlier, accrued compensation drained $43.6M vs $26.5M and deferred revenue $23.0M vs $4.7M - together more than the entire $79.5M year-on-year swing in operating cash flow (-$53.9M vs +$25.6M) - while the non-GAAP operating loss margin was roughly flat at -14.5%, and the fiscal Q2 comp carries no post-year-end collections distortion.

Palo Alto Networks reported the identical quarter (ended 2026-07-31) after the close on 2026-09-01 - one session before Netskope - with SASE bookings up 40% year on year and record next-generation-security net new ARR of ~$970M, and its $450M of SASE competitive displacement TCV was described as taken from legacy vendors rather than SSE pure-plays.

Netskope's live job board carries 143 open requisitions of which 67 are sales-facing (30 with 'Sales' in the title, 14 Regional Sales Manager, 28 Solutions Engineer, 9 Channel), 88 of the 143 were updated in August or September 2026, and a Regional Sales Manager req was updated today, 2026-09-02 - the capacity build management staked its second-half net-new-ARR reacceleration on is still being funded, not quietly frozen.

Three months after announcing on 2026-06-03 that CFO Drew Del Matto would retire 'effective upon the start of a successor', no successor has been named: EDGAR shows the only 8-K since is a 2026-07-09 item 5.07 annual-meeting filing, and the company's own board carries no CFO, Controller or Chief Accounting Officer requisition.

Netskope's third-party-tracked incident history shows an unusual cluster inside the reported quarter - service impacts at SJC1, SJC2, PVG1/PVG2 and AM2 data centres and to BWAN management plane services in the US region during July 2026, culminating on 2026-07-16 in 'Service Impact to Auth Service and Enterprise browser on all DPs', an authentication failure spanning every data plane.
